label: CONTAINMENT_SCOPE_1, respect-wise: a total cause of a thing's being r has r
definition: `ContainmentInTotalCause F Total`: whatever is the efficient and total cause of x's being r (TotalCauseIn at the respect r), where x is in act in r, is itself in act in r. Each perfection is constrained only in the cause that totally causes that very perfection. Act is read uniformly as IN_ACT_4 on both sides.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, the heat example: heat is produced only by something of at least equal order of perfection). Sibling of the whole-effect reading CONTAINMENT_SCOPE_2; neither entails the other in general.
